info.description: Appointment management backend: accounts, patients and the user-patient access model.
info.title: Appointment System API

get.description: Lists doctors in any status, oldest first. Use status=pending for the review queue.
Returns a doctor in any status with its verification history, newest first.

post.description: A reason is required and is stored in the verification history. The doctor resubmits by updating the profile, which moves it back to pending.
A reason is required. A suspended doctor disappears from search.

Refunds a captured payment in full through its gateway. The appointment's payment status becomes refunded. Cancelled paid appointments are refunded automatically; this is for everything else. A gateway with no refund API (YouPI) returns 202 with refundPending true: the refund waits in GET /admin/refunds until an admin pays it back by UPI and completes it.

get.description: Returns every create, edit, finalize, view and download of a record and its files, newest first, with the user and the request's correlation id. It never shows what the record says. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.
get.summary: List who accessed a medical record

get.description: Returns refunds in one status, oldest first. The default, requested, is the queue of refunds to pay back by hand: YouPI has no refund API, so every YouPI refund waits here until an admin sends the money by UPI and completes it. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Records that an admin paid a requested refund back by hand, with the payout's reference such as the UPI UTR (at most 100 characters). The payment and the appointment's payment status become refunded.

get.description: Lists the appointments of every patient the caller has active access to, earliest first. from is inclusive and to exclusive. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Books a free slot of a verified doctor for a patient the caller has full or appointments_only access to. startsAt and mode must match a slot from GET /doctors/{id}/slots; the end time, fee and slot length come from the server.

parameters.description: Client key; a retry with the same key and body returns the first booking
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: Returns an appointment of a patient the caller has active access to, or one where the caller is the doctor. Other appointments are reported as not found.

post.description: Cancels a scheduled appointment that has not started. The patient side needs full or appointments_only access and must cancel at least 2 hours before the start; the doctor can cancel until the start.

get.description: Returns the appointment's most recent payment. The patient side with any active link, the appointment's doctor and admins can see it.

post.description: Opens a gateway order for an unpaid appointment and returns what the client needs to pay it. Anyone with full or appointments_only access to the patient can pay. The amount is the fee stored on the appointment. Asking again while a payment is open returns the same one. The booking must be paid before paymentDueAt, 10 minutes after booking, or it is cancelled.

Moves a scheduled appointment to another free slot of the same doctor. Only the patient side with full or appointments_only access can do it, at least 2 hours before the start. The old appointment is cancelled with reason rescheduled and the new one, returned here, has rescheduledFromId set and keeps the original fee. mode defaults to the current one.

parameters.description: Client key; a retry with the same key and body returns the first result
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: Returns the proposal waiting on an appointment the caller can see: the patient side with any active link, or the appointment's doctor.
get.summary: Get the doctor's pending reschedule proposal

post.description: Moves the appointment to the offered time. The current appointment is cancelled with reason rescheduled and the new one, returned here, has rescheduledFromId set and keeps the payment. Only the patient side with full or appointments_only access can answer, before the proposal expires.
Keeps the current time: the offered time is released and the appointment is scheduled again. Only the patient side with full or appointments_only access can answer, before the proposal expires.

get.description: Streams the file to the patient side with full access, or to the doctor of the record it belongs to. Anyone else gets 404. Every download is written to the access log.

post.description: Log in with exactly one of email or mobileNo and a password.
Revokes the refresh token. Logging out an unknown token still succeeds.
Rotates the refresh token and returns a new jwtToken and refreshToken.

get.description: Lists verified doctors who accept patients. Speciality and tag match any of the given values; all other filters must all match.

parameters.description: Free text over name, qualification, bio and tags
parameters.name: q

post.description: Creates the profile for a doctor account. It starts as pending and is not searchable until an admin verifies it.

put.description: Replaces the profile. A rejected profile, or a verified one whose registration details change, goes back to pending.

get.description: The caller's appointments in any status on one clinic date, earliest first. date defaults to today in the clinic timezone.
get.summary: List the caller's appointments as a doctor for a day

post.description: Marks one of the caller's scheduled appointments as completed. Only the appointment's doctor can do it, only after it has started, and only once it is paid or free.
Marks one of the caller's scheduled appointments as a no-show. Only the appointment's doctor can do it, and only after it has started.
post.summary: Mark an appointment as a no-show

post.description: Opens a draft record for one of the caller's appointments once it has started and is not cancelled. Asking again returns the existing record.
post.summary: Open the medical record of an appointment

post.description: The appointment's doctor offers another free slot. Both the current and the offered time are held, as reschedule_proposed, until the patient side accepts or declines, or the offer expires after 24 hours or at the current start, whichever is first. Only a scheduled appointment that is paid or free and has not started can be moved. mode defaults to the current one.
post.summary: Propose a new time for an appointment

get.description: Weekly rules and the overrides from today on. Times are in the clinic timezone.

put.description: Replaces every weekly rule. dayOfWeek is 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday); times are HH:MM in the clinic timezone, endTime may be 24:00. Blocks on the same day may not overlap, each must fit one slot, and the mode must be one the doctor offers. An empty list clears the schedule.

post.description: For one date from today up to a year ahead. Not available without times is a whole day off; not available with times is a partial leave; available with times is an extra session.
post.summary: Add a leave or an extra session

put.description: Replaces the draft's notes, vitals and prescription. A finalized record cannot change.

post.description: The record's doctor adds a lab report, scan or other file to their draft. Only PDF, JPEG and PNG are kept, detected from the file's content, up to 10 MB.
post.summary: Add a file to a draft medical record

parameters.description: PDF, JPEG or PNG, at most 10 MB
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Date the report was taken, as YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: takenOn

post.description: Locks the draft for good and makes it readable by the patient side with full access. It needs a diagnosis.

get.description: Returns a verified doctor. Doctors in any other status are reported as not found.
Free slots of a verified doctor on one date, from today up to 90 days ahead: weekly rules, minus leave, plus extra sessions. Slots already started today are left out.
get.summary: List a doctor's free slots for a day

get.description: Lists the patients the caller has active access to. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Creates a patient and links it to the caller with full access.

get.description: Returns a patient the caller has active access to. Other patients are reported as not found.

put.description: Updates a patient. Requires full access to the patient.

get.description: Lists the patient's attachments, newest first. Needs full access to the patient; other access levels get 404. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Uploads a lab report, scan or other file for a patient the caller has full access to. Only PDF, JPEG and PNG are kept, detected from the file's content, up to 10 MB.
post.summary: Upload a report for a patient

parameters.description: PDF, JPEG or PNG, at most 10 MB
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Date the report was taken, as YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: takenOn

get.description: Lists the patient's finalized records, newest first. Needs full access to the patient; other access levels get 404. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Confirms with the gateway that the order was paid, captures the payment and marks the appointment paid. With none, send the signature from clientPayload; with YouPI, send the UTR as providerPaymentId and no signature, because the server asks YouPI itself. YouPI's webhook usually captures the payment first, and then this returns it. Verifying a captured payment again with the same providerPaymentId returns it. If the booking expired first, the money is refunded and 409 is returned.

get.description: Returns a record with its attachments. The record's doctor sees it in any status; the patient side needs full access and sees finalized records only. Anyone else gets 404. Every read is written to the access log.
The controlled list of speciality slugs a doctor profile and search can use.

post.description: Called by the configured gateway (YouPI PG), never by clients, so it takes no token. The X-Gateway-Signature HMAC must match the raw body, and a reported payment is confirmed with the gateway again before any money is recorded. Repeats get 200 and change nothing; money for a booking that was already cancelled is recorded and refunded. Any other answer than 2xx makes the gateway retry. The body is limited to 64 KB.

parameters.description: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>
parameters.name: X-Gateway-Signature

Physician focused on diabetes and thyroid care.
